_notes: Original 3AM-rule horror micro-story in the stickman 'rules' format.
cap: *gold* emphasis (rendered white-bright), !red! danger, {TEXT:N} replaces N spoken words.

lines.tts: If your phone ever lights up at three oh seven in the morning,
lines.cap: If your phone ever lights up at {3:07:3} {AM,:3}

lines.tts: and the message is from your own number...
lines.cap: and the message is from your !own! !number...!

lines.tts: Do not read it.
Turn the phone face down.
Close your eyes.
The message always says the same thing.
lines.cap: The message always says the same thing.

lines.tts: Look at the door.
Because if you look, someone will be standing there.
lines.cap: Because if you look, someone will be *standing* *there.*

lines.tts: Someone who looks exactly like you.
It will smile.
And it will wait.
It can only come in if you notice it.
lines.cap: It can only come in if you !notice! !it.!

lines.tts: So keep your eyes shut.
No matter what you hear.
At three thirty-three, the clock will tick,
and it'll be gone.
But here's what nobody tells you.
In the morning, check that message.
If it says read,
then you weren't the one who opened it.
lines.cap: then you weren't the one who *opened* *it.*

lines.tts: Something else did.
And it never left.
Would you have looked? Tell me in the comments.
lines.cap: Would you have *looked?* Tell me in the *comments.*

lines.tts: And follow, so you know what to do next time.
lines.cap: And *follow,* so you know what to do next time.
